## Change Summary

Unreleased regression from #13573 ("Optimize type lookup logic in core schema generation", b75fadb, 2026-08-03). That refactor moved the bare/unsubscripted type dispatch into `_types_handlers`, and bare `collections.abc.MutableSequence` — previously part of `LIST_TYPES` — ended up mapped to `self._sequence_schema(Any)` instead of `self._list_schema(Any)`.

`_sequence_schema` builds an `is_instance_schema(typing.Sequence)`, so mutability is never checked and no coercion happens. On `main` today:

```python
from collections.abc import MutableSequence
from pydantic import TypeA [...]
later_references.title: Use list schema for bare `collections.abc.MutableSequence`

🟠 **High** `_internal/_generate_schema.py:378`

A field annotated with bare `collections.abc.MutableSequence` now raises `PydanticSchemaGenerationError` instead of being treated as a list. The `_get_handlers` dict includes `collections.abc.MutableSet`, `collections.abc.Set`, and `collections.abc.Sequence`, but omits `collections.abc.MutableSequence`, so it falls through to the unknown-schema path. Consider adding `collections.abc.MutableSequence: lambda _: self._list_schema(Any)` alongside the other sequence/collection entries.

The `_handlers` dict changes type dispatch from identity comparison to hash/equality lookup. A custom class whose metaclass defines `__hash__` and `__eq__` to match a built-in key (e.g. comparing equal to `str`) will now silently select that built-in's handler — returning a string schema instead of falling through to arbitrary/custom-type schema generation. packet.body_excerpt:
This is a poor man's version of https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/12575, which does not introduce any new API for core schema generation, and instead focuses only on performance of core schema generation type dispatching.

By taking the proper steps at "decomposing" the arbitrary annotation passed to `generate_schema()`, we can avoid repeated calls to `get_origin()`, `typing._GenericAlias.__eq__()` (all the `obj` in `*_TYPES` calls), etc.

Closes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13541 (better performance here, and better approach too).
packet.objective: Optimize type lookup logic in core schema generation

proposal.title: Optimize type lookup logic in core schema generation

acceptance: Every type the removed TYPES lists matched produces the same core schema as before
Bare and subscripted forms of each collection type dispatch to the handler they used before
Types not in the tables still reach the existing fallback paths

expected.description: Bare collections.abc.MutableSequence used to be in LIST_TYPES and validate as a list; the new table maps it to _sequence_schema(Any), so a str passes validation unchanged and nothing is coerced to a list.

ruling.objective: Replace the sequential type-list checks in core schema generation with dictionary dispatch on the bare type or origin, as an optimisation with no change in the schemas produced
ruling.rationale: PR #13690, merged three weeks later, calls this an unreleased regression: bare collections.abc.MutableSequence was in LIST_TYPES and produced a list schema, and the new dispatch table maps it to _sequence_schema(Any), an is-instance check with no coercion and no mutability check. A review bot flagged the MutableSequence entry during review. The wrong mapping is on a line this diff adds.
